info.title: Meridian API
info.description: Generated from server/api route definitions. See docs/BACKEND_API.md.

get.summary: The signed server list. `payload` is base64 of the exact bytes signed with the fleet key (Ed25519).
The caller's public address as seen by the API, with GeoIP details when a database is configured (else null).

post.summary: Create an account. Always answers 202 (no account enumeration); a verification code is emailed.
Confirm an email address with the emailed code.
Email a new verification code (202 regardless of account existence).
Sign in. Returns tokens, or an MFA challenge when two-factor authentication is on.
Complete sign-in with a TOTP code or a one-time recovery code.
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens. The old refresh token stops working; reusing it ends the session.
End the session belonging to this refresh token.
Email a password reset code (202 regardless of account existence).
Set a new password with the emailed code. Signs out every session.

delete.summary: Delete the account and everything linked to it (devices, sessions, tickets, reports).

post.summary: Change the password. Signs out every other session.
Start TOTP enrolment: returns the secret and otpauth URL (not active until confirmed).
Confirm TOTP with a first code. Returns one-time recovery codes (shown once).
Turn TOTP off (needs the password and a current code).
Sign out every other session.
Register this device's WireGuard key. Idempotent per key. Assigns its tunnel addresses.

put.summary: Replace a device's WireGuard key (key rotation). Keeps its addresses.

delete.summary: Revoke a device. Nodes drop its key on their next sync (within a minute).

get.summary: Which of the account's devices have a live tunnel right now (from node heartbeats; no history is kept).
Peers this node must accept: keys and tunnel addresses of devices with an active entitlement.

post.summary: Node health: WireGuard status and the keys with a recent handshake (kept in memory for 3 minutes, never stored).
Start (or change to) a plan. Returns a hosted checkout URL, or `activated` when the provider needs no payment step.
Cancel at the end of the paid period. Access continues until then; nothing is refunded or cut short.
Undo a pending cancellation.
Mark one read.
Mark all read.
Store a diagnostics report the user chose to send (redacted client-side; 256 KB max).

get.summary: Resolvers that queried <token>.dnscheck.<domain>. Integration point: needs the authoritative DNS probe service (not deployed), so it answers 501.
A ticket with its messages and attachment metadata.

post.summary: Reply on a ticket.
